summary.intent: Address review findings on the workflow-only `callisto init --workflow` path (WP D / F09, tied to issue #357): fix the dry-run mislabel, make detection use the user's own callisto.toml, refuse dropped flags, and correct the changeset wording, then re-gate and push.
summary.outcome: Fixes were applied across the graph and CLI init code, with new tests added for the previously missed mutants. Focused init tests passed and the full gate (pre-push, lint, doc-check, test) was run. The commit was amended and a second cargo-mutants run was started, but its result is not shown, and the push, #357 linking and move to L had not happened yet.

repo: Mutation testing is run with `cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff <diff> --test-tool nextest`, with the diff generated from `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- '*.rs'`.
Builds use CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0, CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 to keep runs light.
The full gate is `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check` and `just test`.
Commits are checked for signatures (`git log --format='%h %G? %s'`), and git is invoked via /usr/bin/git.
Edits to files were scripted via python3 -I edit scripts in /tmp/claude-501, followed by `cargo fmt --all`.
Init tests use helpers like `workspace()`, `run_init`, `run_init_with_runner` and `fake_ls_remote(version)`.

code.finding: `render_init` prints '[DRY-RUN] Would write … (no files written)' whenever `initialized` is false, so a real workflow-only write that reports `initialized: false` is mislabeled as a dry run.

`detect_initialized` calls `detect_facts`, which re-runs `detect_tag_templates` and loads the workspace from a freshly rendered config instead of the user's callisto.toml. This causes spurious E193/E194 tag-template errors and divergent ecosystem, secret and platform detection.

In `run`, the early return to the workflow-only path skips later flag handling, so `--versioning` and `--artifact-target` were silently dropped on initialized workspaces (previously E190). The fix refuses them with `InitAlreadyInitialized`.

workflow: A subagent's source-only review (no build or tests) found real defects. Its findings were verified by reading the cited code before editing.
Edits were held until the background mutation run finished because it uses the same worktree, which avoids corrupting results.
Missed mutants are addressed by adding targeted tests, then re-running mutants on the amended diff.

friction: The background mutation run occupied the worktree, forcing edits to wait.
The first focused test run needed a second pass after the edit12 script before the init tests passed.
The reviewer worked from source only, so the defects it reported had to be checked manually.
open_items: Check the results of the second cargo-mutants run (/tmp/claude-501/mutants2.log) for remaining MISSED mutants.
Push the amended commit and link the trail to #357.
Move on to work package L.
